model.description: R31.5.3: RbSnapNav.render @ rb-snap-nav.ts. Reads the bound rb-strip's COMPARTMENT segments (.rb-seg-compartment) → one button per compartment (label = descriptor label via data-label, fallback data-id); click → seg.scrollIntoView({inline:'start'}) native CSS scroll-snap (NO JS scroll math) + strip.setActive(id) for focus-restore across landscape↔portrait flips. BARS are NOT buttons (compartments-only snap targets). buildButton + wireClick = private helpers. Depends on rb-strip 5.2. Net-new component, wired at instance step. Marker [impl:uuid:7c1f9a3e-...] on the render decl (#126). R31.5.3.
